AvailabilityStatus.description: UNKNOWN is the default so that availability is never invented.
AvailabilityStatus.title: AvailabilityStatus

CostLine.description: One itemised amount. Any sign is allowed: the estimator decides what is valid.
CostLine.title: CostLine

CostLineKind.description: The line items named in plan M5.
CostLineKind.title: CostLineKind

Fee.description: A separately itemised charge, for example a tax or a booking fee.
Fee.title: Fee

FlightDetails.description: Facts only a flight has. Every field is optional: a missing fact stays missing.
FlightDetails.title: FlightDetails

notice.default: Booking is switched off. Approving records your agreement to these exact terms for a short time; it does not book anything or take a payment.
notice.title: Notice

ItineraryRequest.description:
A request to write a day-by-day itinerary for one place (ADR 0004).

It needs only where, when it starts and how many days. There is no origin and no transport:
those belong to the optional search view. `days` counts calendar days including the first.
ItineraryRequest.title: ItineraryRequest

Location.description: A named place. Codes and time zones arrive with the provider interfaces (M3).
Location.title: Location

notice.default: Development stand-in: this reads a few simple patterns in English. It is not a language model, and no model is connected.
notice.title: Notice

Money.description: An amount in one currency. Negative amounts are allowed; callers decide where.
Money.title: Money

PendingDate.description:
A departure date worked out by code from a phrase, waiting for the traveller to say yes.

It is never used until confirmed (ADR 0004). The phrase is one of a fixed pair, so a draft sent
back by the browser cannot carry arbitrary text here.
PendingDate.title: PendingDate

PriceBasis.description:
What a quoted price covers (the owner's answer to PRD Q12, 2026-10-30).

Transport fares are per traveller; hotel prices are per room per night. A quote says which, so
nothing has to guess how to scale it. There is deliberately no default.
PriceBasis.title: PriceBasis

ProblemDetails.description: An error body (RFC 9457), served as `application/problem+json`. See `app.api.problems`.
ProblemDetails.title: ProblemDetails

Provenance.description:
LIVE: fresh provider data. CACHED_LIVE: provider data past its freshness
window. MOCK: deterministic fixture data.
Provenance.title: Provenance

ResearchResults.description: What the research step found, so a caller can show the options and let a person choose.
ResearchResults.title: ResearchResults

RunError.description: A problem in a step. The message is fixed text, never model or provider text.
RunError.title: RunError

SourceMetadata.description: Where a provider-derived value came from and how long it stays fresh.
SourceMetadata.title: SourceMetadata

ToolError.description: One provider failure, kept in the result so the others are still returned.
ToolError.title: ToolError

TransportMode.description: The transport kinds named in PRD FR-02.
TransportMode.title: TransportMode

TransportOption.description:
One way of getting from one place to another.

`operator_name` and `service_label` identify who runs the service and which one it is,
as the provider names them. They are text for display. A mock supplies only fictional
names. `details` carries facts that exist for one mode only, so a train never has a
cabin class. It must match `mode`.
TransportOption.title: TransportOption

Traveller.description: One traveller. Only the age is kept, and only where pricing needs it (SECURITY §7).
Traveller.title: Traveller

TripRequest.description:
A validated request to plan a trip.

`trip_type` is required so that a missing return date can never be read as
a one-way trip by accident.
TripRequest.title: TripRequest

notice.default: No voice provider is connected. This session carries no audio and cannot hear or speak.
notice.title: Notice

WeatherDay.description: The forecast for one calendar day. Facts the provider lacks stay `None`.
WeatherDay.title: WeatherDay

WeatherResult.description: `forecast` is kept even when it has no days, so its source and dates are not lost.
WeatherResult.title: WeatherResult

post.description:
Tell the server the user did something, so the idle timer restarts.

It never extends the absolute time limit. Reading a session (GET) is not activity.
